name: TRMNL proxy
description: Render the next-up screen from your TRMNL account on a Tesserae cell. Paste a device API key, paint whatever playlist is scheduled. The token never leaves the host: Tesserae fetches the envelope from /api/display and proxies the image bytes through itself.

settings.name: access_token
settings.label: Device API key
settings.help: From your TRMNL dashboard: Devices → click the device → Edit → 'Device API Key'.
